parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3663 (Growth factor receptor-bound protein 2). Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce structure presence. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
